title: Bug Hotel Observer
engine: bug-hotel-observer (game-local js/game.js on shared/js/hotspot-scene.js + shared/js/magnifier-lens.js + shared/js/journal.js)
shareTitle: Bug Hotel Observer 🐞 — A Papercraft Magnifying-Glass Bug Hunt
description: Tap a room in a handmade paper bug hotel, then drag a magnifying glass across the leaves, bark, bamboo and old logs to discover the tiny guests hiding inside. Tap a bug to say hello, hear a real bug fact, and keep its sticker in your own Explorer Journal. Twelve bugs, three modes, no timers and nothing to get wrong. Ages 5–6.
learningGoals: Search a busy natural scene carefully and systematically instead of at random
Name twelve common garden minibeasts and tell them apart by sight
Match a spoken description to the creature it describes
Learn one true fact about how each bug lives, and recall it later from its sticker
Practise slow, gentle, patient observation of small living things
interactionModel: tap a room on the hotel exterior, then drag a papercraft magnifying lens across the room plate; bugs are visible only inside the glass until a 600 ms dwell pops them into the scene, and a tap on a found bug plays its name, its animation and its fact card
feedbackModel: Finding a bug pops it into the scene with a spring and a soft chime; tapping it swaps to a happy frame, wiggles, speaks its name and slides a journal spread up with a voiced fact and a sticker that flies into place. A tap on the wrong bug is greeted warmly by name and the prompt is simply offered again — nothing is removed, nothing is scored, nothing can be failed.

modes.title: Bug Hunt
modes.skill: finding and naming a bug that has been named out loud, by searching a natural scene with a magnifying glass

modes.title: Bug Detective
modes.skill: matching a spoken description of a bug to the right bug, with no name given

modes.title: My Bug Book
modes.skill: recalling the bugs already collected and re-hearing each one's name and fact from its sticker

assets.art: All plates, sprites, props and lockups are authored papercraft, generated on the local GenAI API in the Paper Garden art world and finalized deterministically by tools/finalize-art.py. CSS draws no child-facing object — see ASSETS.md and game-design.md §8.
assets.voice: 74 teacher-voice clips cloned from shared/assets/refs/voice-teacher.wav, whisper-QA'd; tools/lines.json is the single source for both the recording script and the Web Speech fallback text.
assets.ambience: Synthesized at runtime via WebAudio (js/ambience.js) — zero audio files.
assets.hubTile: A hub tile candidate is staged at assets/source/hub/tile-candidate.jpg only. assets/hub/tiles/ is hand-curated by the maintainer and is never written by this game's build.

credits: Kaigani; papercraft art and teacher voice generated for QLOBE Kids on the local GenAI API. Concept brief, mockups and concept video by Kaigani. Built with Claude Code for QLOBE Kids.
